name: job-search
description: Root scripts to run infra + API + UI + ATS together

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && pnpm --dir tools/ats-screener install
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k --restart-tries 0 -n api,web,ats -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:ats"
scripts.dev:core: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k --restart-tries 0 -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
